name: 供应商余额看板
description: 直连九家供应商的余额与配额端点，把「还剩多少钱、配额用了多少、什么时候重置」集中到一个面板里：DeepSeek / OpenRouter / Moonshot / MiniMax / Vercel AI Gateway / OpenCode Go / OpenAI Codex。凭据只从本机 pi 的 auth.json 与 models.json 只读解析，请求只发往供应商官方域名。

en.name: Provider Balance
en.description: Queries the balance and quota endpoints of nine providers and puts "how much is left, how much quota is used, when it resets" on one panel: DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot, MiniMax, Vercel AI Gateway, OpenCode Go and OpenAI Codex. Credentials are read-only from the local pi auth.json and models.json; requests go only to each provider's official origin.
en.safetyNotes: Reads credentials from the local pi agent directory (~/.pi/agent/auth.json and models.json) with Node's own fs — the host permission gateway does not mediate raw Node calls, which is the same trade-off pi.token-insights, local.token-meter and local.trajectory already make. It never writes to those files, never copies a key anywhere, and never logs one. Network requests go through the host's pi.net.fetch, confined by manifest.net.domains to the nine official provider origins; a provider configured with a custom baseUrl is refused rather than sent a key to a third-party host. The cached snapshot holds only balances, quota percentages and reset timestamps — no keys, tokens, account identifiers or message text. It declares no fs.*, no session.read, no agent tool and no clipboard permission.

zh-CN.name: 供应商余额看板
zh-CN.description: 直连九家供应商的余额与配额端点，把「还剩多少钱、配额用了多少、什么时候重置」集中到一个面板里：DeepSeek / OpenRouter / Moonshot / MiniMax / Vercel AI Gateway / OpenCode Go / OpenAI Codex。凭据只从本机 pi 的 auth.json 与 models.json 只读解析，请求只发往供应商官方域名。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 用 Node 自身的 fs 从本机 pi 的 agent 目录（~/.pi/agent/auth.json 与 models.json）只读解析凭据——宿主的权限网关不介入原生 Node 调用，这是 pi.token-insights、local.token-meter、local.trajectory 已采用的同一取舍。它从不写回这两个文件，不把 key 复制到任何位置，也不记录到日志。网络请求走宿主的 pi.net.fetch，受 manifest.net.domains 限制在九家供应商的官方 origin 内；配置了自定义 baseUrl 的供应商会被直接拒绝查询，而不是把 key 发到第三方域名。缓存的快照里只有余额、配额百分比与重置时间——没有 key、token、账号标识或消息正文。不声明任何 fs.*、session.read、agent 工具与剪贴板权限。
